fitAnalysis.assessment:
This is a weak fit (32%) for a senior FP&A role requiring M&A, SaaS, and strategic modeling depth you do not yet have.

**Strengths:**
- Budgeting, rolling forecasts, and variance analysis across 5 years of FP&A
- Advanced Excel (VBA automation cut month-end close from 9 to 6 days)
- Forecast accuracy improved from 88% to 96% via backlog-driven model rebuild

**Gaps:**
- No M&A, financial due diligence, or post-merger integration experience
- Missing SaaS-specific skills: unit economics, gross margin, pricing and packaging modeling
- No Anaplan, Workday, or AI workflow tooling experience

**Recommendation:** Build toward this role by targeting a mid-level FP&A analyst position at a SaaS or tech company first, where you can gain the domain context and strategic modeling experience this Finance Manager role requires.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Okta

Dear Hiring Manager,

Okta's Technology FP&A team needs someone who can own budgeting and forecasting for a newly formed organization while keeping variance reporting sharp enough to drive real decisions. That's the work I've been doing for the past five years: at Calder Industrial Components, I rebuilt a forecasting model around order backlog data and moved accuracy from 88% to 96% for a business unit inside an ~$85 million revenue portfolio.

As a Financial Analyst supporting two business units, I've run the full monthly cycle: rolling forecasts, budget-versus-actual variance analysis, close collaboration with the controllership team on accruals, and management reporting for senior stakeholders. When the close process was taking too long, I automated journal checks in Excel VBA and cut reporting time from nine working days to six. That builder instinct, finding where a process is slow and fixing it, maps directly to Okta's emphasis on process improvement and scaling. My advanced Excel skills and experience translating operational data into clear dashboards for non-finance audiences would carry into the cross-functional partnering this role requires, and my B.S. in Finance and ongoing ACCA studies give me the technical foundation to grow into the broader analytical scope Okta is looking for.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my forecasting and reporting background can contribute to Okta's FP&A organization, and I'm available at your convenience.

Sincerely,
Tomas Brandt
